sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed page 198 preserves the conclusion of the Dur/Moll section: vectorial Rand/Mitte comparison, harmony/disharmony between Rand and Mitte, and possible collective use. Fall 10 and Fall 8 are cited by Szondi as contrasting worked examples rather than separate method definitions.

sourceExcerpt: Die Methode ist ferner geeignet zur Bestimmung der ko/Ak/iven Geschlechtsproportionen von normalen Alters-, Berufs- und Krank/eits-Gruppen.
romanianRendering: La încheierea secțiunii Dur/Moll, Szondi extinde metoda dincolo de raportul total: analiza poate urmări separat ce tendință predomină la Rand și în Mitte, poate examina armonia sau dizarmonia dintre aceste zone și poate fi aplicată și proporțiilor colective ale unor grupuri.
doctrinalStatement: Metoda Dur/Moll nu se limitează la un raport global. În formularea sursei, ea permite o analiză vectorială Rand–Mitte și evaluarea relației de armonie/dizarmonie dintre tendințele Dur/Moll ale Rand-ului și ale Mitte; Szondi declară de asemenea metoda aplicabilă descriptiv grupurilor colective. Fall 10 și Fall 8 rămân exemple de contrast pentru armonie/dizarmonie, nu reguli autonome despre persoane sau grupuri.
conditions: Use only after the source-defined Dur/Moll calculation has been obtained for a ten-profile series.
Keep total and vectorial Dur/Moll summaries distinct.
exceptions: Do not use the method as a contemporary sex, gender, sexual-orientation, age, occupation or disease-group classifier.
Do not generalize Fall 10 or Fall 8 beyond their role as worked source examples.
scopeNotes: The source explicitly asks which Dur/Moll tendency has the upper hand at Rand and in Mitte and whether harmony or disharmony exists between them.
The source's proposed collective application is historical and does not itself establish modern normative validity.

relations.note: Extends the ten-series Dur/Moll calculation from the total ratio to vectorial Rand/Mitte comparison.
Preserves the source's relational and group-level uses without turning the current Dur/Moll state into an invariant trait.

ambiguities: Canonical OCR damages several words in U003051-U003055; printed page 198 resolves the Rand/Mitte and harmony/disharmony wording.
reviewNotes: Canonical BODY U003051-U003055 checked against deterministic P0 evidence and admitted PDF printed page 198.
